label: Worst-slew merging at a pin
subgoals: Compute each input arc's output slew
Take the largest as the stored slew
Note that it may come from a different input than the latest arrival

label: Downstream arrival under graph-based analysis
subgoals: Take the latest arrival at the merging pin
Evaluate the next arc's delay at the merged worst slew
Add that delay to the arrival

label: Path-based re-timing removes the pessimism
subgoals: Identify the input that carries the critical path
Re-evaluate downstream delays with that input's own slew
Subtract to find the pessimism the merge added
